All four counterbalanced pairs favored this path. Every generated token, 248,320-way first-logit vector and all 25 physical cache histories agreed bit for bit. Median round maximum fell by 15.8 MiB. Decoding measured 101.63 and 101.75 tokens/s. A prior numeric probe retained extra allocation in the last stock timing round, so its peak exaggerates the typical memory difference. All 64 timed runs were preserved. A serialization error required a separate untimed replay of the state fingerprints.
